title: Comparing Reciprocal Pair Graphs: Cosine/Secant and Sine/Cosecant
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: (a) Graph y = \cos x and y = \sec x together on [-3\pi/2, 3\pi/2] and explain how the behavior of \sec x relates to the signs and values of \cos x. (b) Graph y = \sin x and y = \csc x together on [-\pi, 2\pi] and explain how \csc x relates to the signs and values of \sin x.
finalAnswer: \sec x = \frac{1}{\cos x} \text{ and } \csc x = \frac{1}{\sin x} \text{ share signs with } \cos x \text{ and } \sin x, \text{ have vertical asymptotes at their zeros, and meet them at } y = \pm 1

steps.title: Analyze Part (a): Sign Agreement and Asymptotes of sec x = 1/cos x
steps.explanation: On [-3*pi/2, 3*pi/2], sec x has the exact same sign as cos x on every open interval: positive on (-pi/2, pi/2) and negative on [-3*pi/2, -pi/2) and (pi/2, 3*pi/2]. Wherever cos x = 0, sec x has a vertical asymptote.
steps.why: A reciprocal 1/u preserves the sign of u and diverges to infinity as u approaches 0.

steps.title: Analyze Part (a): Extrema Duality Between cos x and sec x
steps.explanation: Where cos x attains its local maximum of 1 (at x = 0), sec x attains a local minimum of 1; where cos x attains its local minimum of -1 (at x = +/-pi), sec x attains a local maximum of -1. Whenever cos x decreases in magnitude toward 0, |sec x| increases toward infinity.
steps.why: Since |cos x| <= 1, its reciprocal satisfies |sec x| = 1/|cos x| >= 1, reversing increasing and decreasing behavior.

steps.title: Analyze Part (b): Sign Agreement, Asymptotes, and Extrema of csc x = 1/sin x
steps.explanation: On [-pi, 2*pi], csc x and sin x have the same sign: positive on (0, pi) and negative on (-pi, 0) and (pi, 2*pi). Vertical asymptotes of csc x occur at the zeros x = -pi, 0, pi, 2*pi of sin x, while the curves touch at (pi/2, 1) (max of sin, min of csc) and at (-pi/2, -1) and (3*pi/2, -1) (min of sin, max of csc).
steps.why: By the reciprocal relation csc x = 1/sin x, zeros of sin x become vertical asymptotes of csc x and unit extrema coincide.
